enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Adjust blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Close lid. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with kettle and toaster
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out bread and butter. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Wait for toast. Remove toast. Butter toast. Pour hot water into cup. Add tea bag. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Clear dishes. Rinse dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Put laptop in bag. Put notebook in bag. Put pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Walk out.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails, and meeting partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone calls. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss with colleagues. Coordinate program. Meet partner organization. Prepare materials. Print documents. Organize files.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Order food. Pay. Receive food. Find table. Sit. Eat. Drink. Talk to colleague. Finish meal. Clear tray. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work at the nonprofit office: preparing program materials and planning upcoming community events
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open program materials. Review notes. Edit documents. Print materials. Make phone calls. Plan event. Meet with team. Assign tasks. Update calendar. Send emails. Organize files.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Remove shoes. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn on oven. Place dish in oven. Set timer. Wait. Turn off induction cooker. Remove pan.
Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Eat. Drink water. Put down utensils. Wipe mouth. Clear plate. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load cups. Load utensils. Close dishwasher. Press start. Wipe table. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer at the desk with the desk lamp to review program notes and plan the next day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open program notes. Read notes. Type notes. Open calendar. Plan next day. Type schedule. Save file. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Undress. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down on the bed, checking phone and reading
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through apps. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Close eyes.
Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Adjust blanket. Continue sleeping.
